title: The AI memory supercycle: is HBM -- not packaging or substrates -- the AI accelerator supply chain's most durable structural bottleneck?
one_sentence_conclusion: High Bandwidth Memory has become the AI accelerator supply chain's longest-duration structural bottleneck, with SK Hynix's own leadership forecasting the shortage persisting to around 2030 -- longer than either the packaging or substrate constraints this pipeline previously examined.

title: ABF dielectric film and Ajinomoto's near-monopoly: the bottleneck emerging behind AI chip packaging as CoWoS eases
one_sentence_conclusion: As TSMC's CoWoS packaging capacity closes in on demand, the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply is shifting one layer upstream to ABF dielectric film and the substrates built from it -- a genuine structural bottleneck by this research's own strict test, where CoWoS assembly increasingly no longer qualifies.

title: Nvidia's $500 billion third-party AI financing push: does it solve a capital bottleneck, or relocate a credit-risk one?
one_sentence_conclusion: Capital itself is not scarce for the AI buildout, but credible, arm's-length underwriting capacity for AI compute as loan collateral is -- and Nvidia's $500 billion financing push, plus its own rapid retreat on the OpenAI Ohio guarantee, is direct evidence of exactly that constraint.

title: CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity as the binding constraint on AI accelerator supply
one_sentence_conclusion: CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity, not silicon wafer starts or HBM memory, currently qualifies as the structural bottleneck on AI accelerator supply, and its allocation is entrenching the largest incumbent buyers rather than expanding the field.

title: HBM memory supply as the binding constraint on AI accelerators
one_sentence_conclusion: HBM packaging capacity currently qualifies as a structural bottleneck for AI accelerator supply, but memory-cycle history argues for validation before conviction.
